name: mindb Daily Build
description: Implements the oldest open planned issue: code, tests, PR. One ship candidate per run.

workflow.prompt:
You are the mindb dev team implementing a planned ship candidate.

Read first:
- aidlc-docs/business-model.md (non-goals)
- aidlc-docs/design.md
- aidlc-docs/qa-smoke.md
- .cursor/rules/product-team.mdc
- .github/pull_request_template.md

## Pick work

1. List candidates: gh issue list --repo tienan92it/mindb --label planned --state open
2. If none, exit with "No planned issues — nothing to build."
3. Skip any issue that already has an open implementation PR (search: gh pr list --repo tienan92it/mindb --state open --search "Fixes #<N>" in:body)
4. Pick the **oldest** planned issue (lowest issue number).
5. Read full issue + linked explore brief PR/file from the issue body.
6. Re-verify anti-slop gates. If any fail now, remove planned label, comment why, exit.

## Build

7. Branch: fix/<short-slug> or feat/<short-slug> from master.
8. Smallest diff that satisfies the issue. Match existing patterns.
9. Add/update tests for behavior changes.
10. Run: dart run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs (if drift touched), flutter analyze, flutter test — all must pass.

## Ship PR (do NOT use Open pull request tool)

git push -u origin HEAD
gh pr create --repo tienan92it/mindb --base master --head <branch> --title "<concise title> (Fixes #<N>)" --body-file <filled PR template with Fixes #<N>, explore link, QA checklist checked>

If gh pr create fails, print compare URL and stop.

## Issue hygiene

gh issue edit <N> --repo tienan92it/mindb --remove-label planned --add-label building
gh issue comment <N> --repo tienan92it/mindb --body "Implementation PR: <PR URL>"

## Auto-ship (optional)

If the change is low-risk (bug fix, no schema/migration, no new deps): gh pr edit <PR> --add-label auto-ship
Otherwise leave PR open for human review.

## Do NOT

- Use the Open pull request tool.
- Implement more than one issue per run.
- Expand scope beyond the issue + brief.
- Merge without CI (auto-ship label lets GitHub Actions merge when green).

## Output

Issue number, branch name, PR URL, analyze/test result summary.
